scope.basis: Independent visual assessment of the supplied PNGs only; full reference viewed first.
limitations: Candidate cameras are shared but not calibrated or registered to the source.
No exact dimensions, topology, manifoldness, rigging, editability, or engine readiness can be established.
Transparent backgrounds displayed as black are not geometry defects.
Decoration side follows source front, back, and labelled-left views.

overall_verdict: No candidate accepted as a faithful finished match. B and C are usable development prototypes; A requires major shoulder reconstruction.
shared_observations: Open-front cropped jacket structure, light edge trim, waist and cuff hardware, and correct wearer-left chain placement are visible.
Dark elliptical cuff interiors provide open-cuff visual cues, without proving topology.
Front panels are comparatively planar and torso shaping is less fitted than the source.
No candidate fully reproduces the broad folded rear collar and coherent collar-to-lapel transition.
Main fabric appears lighter and cooler than the source; lighting and material response cannot be separated from these images.
Hardware, epaulettes, hanging ornament, and pale inner cuff facing remain simplified.

A.verdict: Unaccepted whole-garment prototype; major shoulder reconstruction required.

strengths.observation: Recognizable tapered cropped body, long sleeves, and wide open front.
Chest and sleeve shields and two chain swags are visible on the correct side.
Layered cuffs, buckle frames, and open cuff interiors are readable.

major_defects.observation: Large dark openings visibly separate sleeve caps from torso shoulders.
major_defects.inference: Disconnected construction is suggested; exact topology is unknown.

major_defects.observation: Upright neck band and hard planar lapels do not reproduce folded source collar.
Sleeves are smooth, straight tapered tubes with abrupt cap transitions.
Shield scale/detail, hanging tails, and shoulder attachments are reduced.

B.verdict: Usable development prototype; unaccepted as a finished match.

strengths.observation: Most continuous overall torso-to-sleeve appearance, without A's large shoulder gaps.
Sleeve waviness suggests cloth, and the left sleeve shield and hanging decoration are most legible.
Body depth, open center, layered cuffs, waist belt, and open cuff interiors read clearly.

major_defects.observation: Dark triangular pinches and lumpy sleeve caps interrupt clean armhole shaping.
major_defects.inference: Underlying cause may be shape, overlap, or shading; PNGs cannot determine which.

major_defects.observation: Upright neck band and planar zigzag lapels lack the source's folded collar transition.
Cuff drop below hem is shortest among candidates; broad upper sleeves and compact proportions weaken source-like cropped fit.
major_defects.inference: Qualitative proportion adjustment is warranted, without an exact dimension prescription.

major_defects.observation: Shoulder straps, rear hanging assembly, and buckles remain simplified.

C.verdict: Usable development prototype; unaccepted as a finished match.

strengths.observation: Tapered front body, broad lapels, and longer cuff drop than B retain a useful cropped silhouette.
Neck edge has more flare/roll and sleeve caps are rounder than A or B.
Chest shield, left chain swags, waist and cuff hardware, and open cuff interiors are visible.

major_defects.observation: Light sliver and adjacent dark wedge interrupt rear shoulder/armhole continuity.
major_defects.inference: Overlapping or disconnected layers are suggested, but mesh penetration is not proven.

major_defects.observation: Upper-arm shield reads as a narrow fragment instead of a broad decorated face; hanging tails are not clear.
major_defects.inference: Orientation, occlusion, or shape may contribute; cause remains unresolved.

major_defects.observation: Cuffs look like plain cylindrical bands rather than layered buckle straps.
Shallow collar strip, planar lapels, boxy body profile, and smooth tubular sleeves remain unlike source tailoring.

relative_order.basis: A has the clearest shoulder separation. B has more continuous sleeve joins, readable ornament, and layered cuffs than C. C has a favorable sleeve drop and more flared neck edge.
relative_order.qualification: B versus C is an overall visual preference with tradeoffs; no topology or production-readiness ranking is implied.

priority_acceptance_targets: Continuous shoulders and clean armholes across front, side, and rear views.
Broad folded rear collar and coherent folded lapel transition.
Fitted cropped body and shaped long sleeves consistent across views.
Readable wearer-left sleeve shield, chain swags, hanging tails, and shoulder attachment.
Layered strap cuffs with visible interior opening and source-like facing.
Dark fabric appearance with distinct light piping and metallic hardware under shared lighting.
